name: Interstellar Strike Team
storyline: A mysterious enemy spreads through the galaxy, prompting the construction of a massive spaceport and the preparation for war.
summary:
Interstellar Strike Team is a VR co-op game where up to six players fight alien robots across space and planets. Players can pilot interceptors, command battleship systems, and engage in ground combat. Teamwork is key, and rewards are distributed equally.

Players can control joysticks and throttles in interactive VR cockpits, engage in space combat and ground missions, and repair systems.
